462:t_004:50.en:
$$赤木$$
「Behold the birth of the golden tag team: $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$ and $$２１世紀警備保障$$!」

462:t_004:51.en:
$$百目鬼$$
「Love it! A gold-loving, penny-pinching duo!」

462:t_004:52.en:
$$メール$$
「If $$クロウ$$ were here, it would have been a trio.」

462:t_004:53.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'm relieved that guy isn't in our unit this time.」

462:t_004:54.en:
$$タケル$$
「A-anyway...! The company vault matters, but we have to protect Earth's peace!」

462:t_004:55.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$タケル$$ is right. Let's do our best, President $$ワッ太$$.」

462:t_004:56.en:
$n
「$$ワッ太$$, $$赤木$$! If you want to pay off your debt, defeat the enemy yourselves!」

462:t_004:57.en:
$$赤木$$
「Wait, $n! It's not a debt yet!」

462:t_004:58.en:
$$勝平$$
「I don't care, just hurry up! The enemy can't wait to get us!」

462:t_004:60.en:
$$赤木$$
「All right! Protect the city and clear the deficit too! We're doing both!!」

462:t_005:0.en:
$$恵子$$
「Be careful! The dimensional boundary is warping!」

462:t_005:1.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Don't tell me, $$宇宙怪獣$$!? Or the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s!」

462:t_005:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Either one is fine by me! If they come, we'll just blast them!」

462:t_006:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「$$バンドック$$...! It's $$ガイゾック$$'s $$バンドック$$!」

462:t_006:3.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Impossible! We defeated that thing in the $$多元戦争$$!」

462:t_006:4.en:
$$恵子$$
「There's a robot army around $$バンドック$$ too!」

462:t_006:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then that clay-figure mech is the boss of those guys!」

462:t_006:6.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「$$ガバールニウム$$ confirmed. It should have been placed under my control when I subjugated $$ガバール星$$.」

462:t_006:7.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「I do not permit the existence of anything outside my control. I will destroy it at once.」

462:t_007:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You bastard! Are you going after $$トライダー$$, when it just got its brand-new upgrade!?」

462:t_007:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「That's not the $$ガイゾック$$ we defeated in the $$多元戦争$$...!」

462:t_007:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「It's the thing that took over $$シグマ$$ on Uncle $$梅本$$'s $$ガバール星$$!」

462:t_007:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What's that supposed to mean, $$勝平$$!?」

462:t_007:6.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We'll talk later, $$ワッ太$$! That thing... is humanity's enemy!」

462:t_007:7.en:
$$勝平$$
「Hey, you! Why did you come to Earth!」

462:t_007:8.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「I am $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ No. 21... My mission is to eliminate humans with evil thoughts from the universe.」

462:t_007:9.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$コンピュータードール#pilot$$...! So basically it's a machine!」

462:t_007:10.en:
$$シモン$$
「So this thing also wants to mess with humans over its own selfish logic, like the $$ストライカー#robot$$ of the $$霧の海$$!」

462:t_007:11.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Admit that you yourselves are evil.」

462:t_007:13.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Hating each other, lying to each other, killing each other... Such creatures destroy the quiet peace of the universe.」

462:t_007:14.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「I was created to clean up such creatures.」

462:t_007:15.en:
$$勝平$$
「That's not true...! Everyone I know is a good person!」

462:t_008:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「$$ガイゾック$$! Now I can say for sure that what you're saying is total garbage!」

462:t_008:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「Sure, there are bad guys! But the universe isn't full of only those kinds of guys!」

462:t_008:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「If it were, there's no way Uncle $$梅本$$, who ran away from the $$ガバール星$$ you control, could be happy on Earth!」

462:t_008:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「Everybody! Don't let this thing fool you!」

462:t_008:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「This thing only looks at the bad side of humans and says whatever it likes!」

462:t_008:7.en:
$$勝平$$
「But I have no intention of becoming the kind of guy this thing is talking about!」

462:t_008:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「Even if nobody thanks me, even if I get hurt, I'll protect the people who matter to me... I'll protect Earth!!」

462:t_008:10.en:
$$恵子$$
「That's why we ride $$ザンボット$$!」

462:t_008:11.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Heh... You sure can talk, can't you!」

462:t_008:12.en:
$$万丈$$
「Everyone! We can't let $$勝平$$ outdo us!」

462:t_008:13.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Roger! $$ザンボット$$'s moonlight will light our way!」

462:t_008:16.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Correction judged impossible... Then I will eliminate you.」

462:t_008:17.en:
$$勝平$$
「Try it if you can! I'll show you humanity's strength... how wonderful it is!」

462:t_009:0.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「My system has been destroyed... There is one last thing I wish to ask...」

462:t_009:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「To protect what matters to us!」

462:t_009:4.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Cannot... comprehend... Humans... abandon... civilization...」

462:t_009:5.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Otherwise... what awaits... beyond that... is despair.........」

462:t_010:2.en:
$$赤木$$
「But with this, the boss computer that was controlling the robot army has fallen.」

462:t_010:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Won't those guys come to Earth anymore?」

462:t_010:5.en:
$$万丈$$
「The $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ we fought in the $$多元戦争$$ was No. 8... The one we fought today was No. 21.」

462:t_010:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「So that bastard's still out there somewhere, huh.」

462:t_010:7.en:
$$タケル$$
「It might come to Earth again and call humanity an evil species.」

462:t_010:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「Then I'll fight it...! Even if nobody thanks me, even if I get hurt!」

462:t_010:10.en:
$n
「You're not alone, $$勝平$$. Don't forget about us.」

462:t_010:11.en:
$$甲児$$
「Isn't that the wonderful side of humanity you were talking about?」

462:t_010:13.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Thanks to $$２１世紀警備保障$$'s guidance, the citizens suffered almost no damage too.」

462:t_010:14.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, return to base. Now that the battle is over, there's no reason to linger.」

462:t_012:0.en:
$$木下$$
「Team 'Salaryman' has broken through 25000 in earned funds!」
